description: This file defines a class WidgetsBundlesTableConfigResolver that configures and manages the behavior of a widgets bundle table in an Angular application, including actions like import, export, open, and delete, as well as handling row clicks and permissions based on user authority.

classes.name: WidgetsBundlesTableConfigResolver
classes.description: An Angular service class that provides configuration for a widgets bundle table, including data loading, actions, permissions, and navigation.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for WidgetsBundle, setting up fetch functions and permissions based on user authority.

methods.name: isWidgetsBundleEditable
methods.description: Determines if a widgets bundle is editable based on user authority and tenant ID.

methods.name: importWidgetsBundle
methods.description: Handles importing a widgets bundle via the importExport service and updates the table data.

methods.name: openWidgetsBundle
methods.description: Navigates to the widget types page for a specific widgets bundle.

methods.name: openWidgetsBundleDetails
methods.description: Navigates to the detailed view of a widgets bundle.

methods.name: exportWidgetsBundle
methods.description: Exports a specific widgets bundle using the importExport service.

methods.name: onWidgetsBundleAction
methods.description: Handles actions triggered on widgets bundle entities such as open, openDetails, and export.
